about: Machines whose setup is known from their own boots. A build whose scan matches board AND cpu (case-insensitive substrings) gets these settings; a failed boot's own log still overrides them. status: works = the owner reached the desktop with it; fix-sent = built from the machine's own logs, not confirmed yet.

machines.source: owner report 10-10: desktop with the driver installed (OpenCore 1.0.5, macOS 15.8.1, Above 4G + ReBAR on)
own stick logs 10-07/08: installed system stopped at EB.MM.AKM / STOP 0x16 with DevirtualiseMmio off; DSDT repaired by dsdt_pass1
